from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.builder.getOrCreate()

path = "abfss://dgt@navispowerbidatastorage2.dfs.core.windows.net/gold/conformities"

# 1. Read and check before
df = spark.read.format("delta").load(path)
total = df.count()
distinct = df.dropDuplicates().count()
print(f"Rows: {total} | Distinct rows: {distinct} | Duplicates: {total - distinct}")

# 2. Stop if there's nothing to clean
if total == distinct:
    print("No exact duplicates found. Nothing to do.")
else:
    # 3. Deduplicate and materialise BEFORE overwriting the same path
    clean = df.dropDuplicates().cache()
    clean_count = clean.count()

# 4. Overwrite the table
    (clean.write
          .format("delta")
          .mode("overwrite")
          .option("overwriteSchema", "true")
          .save(path))

    # 5. Verify
    after = spark.read.format("delta").load(path)
    print(f"After: {after.count()} rows (expected {clean_count})")
    clean.unpersist()
